## Form I-9, Section 1

**B01 · Last name**

SURNAME_P1

**B02 · First name**

GIVEN_P1

**B03 · Middle initial**  
Enter only the first letter of your middle name by hand.

MIDDLE_P1

**B04 · Other last names used**  
Leave blank. You’ve never used another last name.

**B05–B09 · U.S. home address**

- **B05 · Street number and name** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter your new home street address.
- **B06 · Apartment number** — NEEDS-YOU if your new address has an apartment number. Otherwise, leave blank.
- **B07 · City or town** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter the city or town where you live.
- **B08 · State** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter the state where you live.
- **B09 · ZIP code** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter your home ZIP code.

**B10 · Date of birth**  
Enter the restored date by hand in month/day/year order, using two digits for the month and day and four for the year.

DATE_P1

**B11 · U.S. Social Security number**  
NEEDS-YOU. You don’t have a U.S. Social Security number yet. Ask your employer how to handle this field while you’re waiting for it.

**B12 · Email address**  
NEEDS-YOU. Enter your email address directly on the form.

**B13 · Telephone number**

PHONE_P1

**B14 · Citizenship or immigration status**  
Check **box 4, “An alien authorized to work until,”** and enter **09/30/2029**.

**B15 · Foreign passport number and country of issuance**  
Enter **Philippines** as the country of issuance and use this passport number.

ID_P1

**B16 · Employee signature**  
NEEDS-YOU. Sign the form yourself.

**B17 · Today’s date**  
NEEDS-YOU. Enter the date you actually sign in **mm/dd/yyyy** format.
